description: This Java class 'ComponentLoaderConfig' manages the loading and parsing of component loader XML files ('component-load.xml') for the Apache OFBiz framework. It provides methods to retrieve root component configurations, parse configuration files, and define component structures (individual components or directories) based on the XML structure.

classes.name: ComponentLoaderConfig
classes.description: Final utility class for managing component loader configuration files and their parsing in OFBiz.

classes.name: ComponentLoaderConfig.ComponentDef
classes.description: Represents a component or component directory, encapsulating its location and type, and providing a factory method to create instances from XML elements.

methods.name: ComponentLoaderConfig.getRootComponents
methods.description: Retrieves a list of root component definitions defined in the classpath, throwing an exception if the configuration is invalid.

methods.name: ComponentLoaderConfig.getComponentsFromConfig
methods.description: Parses a given 'component-load.xml' resource URL to extract component definitions.

methods.name: ComponentLoaderConfig.ComponentDef.of
methods.description: Creates a ComponentDef instance from an XML element, recognizing 'load-component' and 'load-components' elements.

methods.name: ComponentLoaderConfig.parseDocumentFromUrl
methods.description: Reads and parses an XML document from a given URL, with appropriate exception handling.
